title: 第4章 第三卦，大凶-《开局三预言？我直播通关S级末世》
content:
第(1/3)页

    靳业平说完话，才发现家里的气氛似乎不太对。

    他环顾四周，视线最终落在靳泽宇身上，语气中带着点责备：

    “泽宇，你都这么大个人了，怎么把家里搞成这样？没有吵到妹妹休息吧？”

    说完，才看到靳兰玦的房门大开。

    远远的，看到她就站在窗边。

    两人视线相对，靳业平目光一闪，抬手揉揉额头，挡住了自己的神情。

    “哎呀你们……”靳业平放下手，叹气，“都是一家人，大晚上吵架吵成这样，妹妹一直身体不好，你们不要吵她休息呀。”

    靳兰玦脑袋里面嗡嗡作响，嘴角勾起一抹嘲讽的弧度。

    她这个小叔，看上去是世外高人，一副与世无争的样子，实际上他才是最阴毒的那个人。

    上一世被献祭死前，还是靳泽宇亲口告诉她，提出布下法阵吸收她气运的人，就是小叔靳业平！

    靳家其他人都对她非打即骂，只有小叔始终对她温声细语，每次都会在家人面前维护她，保护她。

    曾经，她不止一次在想，如果自己是小叔的孩子就好了。

    小叔这样温柔的人，当他的女儿一定会很幸福吧？

    然而谁能想到，自己上一世遭遇的所有苦难，始作俑者居然是她一直崇敬的小叔！

    一想到这里，她周身似乎又燃烧起诡后祭坛上炙热的火焰。

    得知真相时心脏的抽痛，将身体被火焰灼伤的剧痛都压了下去。

    此时看到靳业平这一副无辜的样子，靳兰玦只觉得血液直冲头顶，撞得她眼珠子都在微微震颤。

    靳泽宇像是找到了主心骨，刚迎上去两步：“小叔！您终于来了！都怪……”

    靳业平已经抬脚走向靳兰玦的房间门口：

    “兰玦呀，听说你在家里做直播兼职？

    只是这时间上，是不是有点太晚了呀？你看你本来身体就不好，更需要休息好才行……”

    他又看了眼自家大哥，叹气：

    “你说你也是，孩子大了，又自己的想法是好事，你好好说就好了嘛。

    兰玦是女孩子，你不要用对儿子的那套对她呀！”

    靳兰玦只是静静注视着他，血液在体内奔窜，左冲右突想找一个宣泄的出口。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

After Jin Yeping finished speaking, he realized that the atmosphere at home seemed not right.

He looked around, and finally his eyes fell on Jin Zeyu, with a bit of reproach in his tone:

"Zeyu, you are such a big man, how can you make the house like this? You didn't disturb your sister to rest, did you?"

After saying that, he saw Jin Lanjue's door open.

From a distance, I saw her standing by the window.

The two looked at each other. Jin Yeping's eyes flashed and he raised his hand to rub his forehead to block his expression.

"Oh, you guys..." Jin Yeping put down his hands and sighed, "We are all a family. They are quarreling like this at night. My sister has been in poor health. Don't disturb her to rest."

Jin Lanjue's head was buzzing, and the corners of his mouth curled up in a mocking arc.

Her brother-in-law seems to be a worldly expert and looks like he has nothing to do with the world, but in fact he is the most sinister person.

Before she was sacrificed and died in her last life, Jin Zeyu personally told her that the person who suggested setting up a magic circle to absorb her luck was his uncle Jin Yeping!

The rest of the Jin family beat and scolded her, but her brother-in-law always spoke softly to her and defended and protected her in front of her family every time.

Once upon a time, she thought more than once that it would be great if she were her uncle's child.

"A gentle person like my uncle will be very happy to be his daughter, right?"

However, who would have thought that the culprit of all the suffering she encountered in her previous life was actually her brother-in-law whom she had always admired!

When she thought of this, her whole body seemed to be burning with the hot flames on the Queen's Altar.

When I learned the truth, my heart throbbed and I suppressed the severe pain of my body being burned by the flames.

Seeing Jin Yeping's innocent look at this time, Jin Lanjue felt blood rushing to the top of her head, making her eyes tremble slightly.

Jin Zeyu seemed to have found his backbone and took two steps forward: "Uncle! You are finally here! It's all my fault..."

Jin Yeping has already walked towards the door of Jin Lanjue's room:

"Lan Jue, I heard that you are doing live streaming part-time at home?

It’s just that at this time, isn’t it a little too late?You see, you are not in good health to begin with, and you need more rest..."

He looked at his eldest brother again and sighed:

"You said it's the same for you. Your child is older and your thoughts are good things. You just have to speak up.

Lan Jue is a girl, don’t treat her the same way you treat your son!"

Jin Lanjue just stared at him quietly, blood rushing through his body, rushing left and right to find an outlet to vent.
